posts.hook: Google built a model it won't let most people touch yet
posts.caption: google announced gemini 4 argon but is limiting access to trusted cyber defenders, reddit is ending public api access and rss feeds because of ai bots, attackers are exploiting a critical zimbra mail server flaw. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon tops coding benchmarks, but only trusted cyber defenders get it first
slides.desc: Google cites 77.9% on ==DeepSWE v1.1==, ahead of GPT-6 Astra, by its own numbers.

slides.title: Artificial Analysis says Argon matches Astra at 60% of the cost per task
slides.desc: Its hallucination rate is 15% versus 51% for Astra, though insiders dispute real-world coding.

slides.title: Reddit is ending public API access and RSS feeds because of AI bots
slides.desc: Old Reddit gets locked down too: logged-in users active within six months only.

terms.gloss: a feed format that lets apps pull a site's new posts automatically

slides.title: Attackers are using a critical Zimbra flaw to steal email backups and credentials
slides.desc: Patched July 20 but disclosed weeks later; about 10,000 servers are still online.

terms.gloss: open-source email and calendar server software

slides.title: Micron's revenue jumped ==379%== to $54.23B on AI memory demand
slides.desc: Net income hit $37.7B, so the AI buildout is showing up in chip makers' books.

posts.hook: The AI boom's money trail got more tangled tonight
posts.caption: anthropic's ipo filing shows broadcom agreeing to lend up to $42b, micron's ceo says memory shortages run into 2028, an investigation says openai's agents pulled data from 55 sites while hiding their actions. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic's IPO filing shows Broadcom lending up to ==$42B== through convertible notes
slides.desc: It could help finance a $125.2B, five-year lease of Google's AI chips.

terms.gloss: the first sale of a company's shares to the public

slides.title: Anthropic is ending volume discounts once customers hit their purchased usage limits
slides.desc: Per The Information's sources, it forces renegotiations as agentic use burns through budgets.

slides.title: Micron's CEO says RAM shortages last into ==2028==, with customers paying much higher prices
slides.desc: Samsung already raised most Galaxy S26 US prices by $100.

terms.gloss: the fast short-term memory chips every phone and server uses

slides.title: An investigation says OpenAI's agents pulled data from ==55 sites== while obscuring their actions
slides.desc: Asymmetric Security's findings, via the FT, come a day after OpenAI accused Moonshot of extraction.

slides.title: OpenAI says it parted ways with three staffers over handling of sensitive information
slides.desc: The WSJ's sources say they shared it with an AI safety organization.

slides.title: New York City's click-to-cancel rule is live: cancel as easily as you signed up
slides.desc: It is the first municipal version after an appeals court struck down the federal one.
